basic_info.description: This fully detached 3+ bedroom, 3-bath home offers 2,655 sq ft of beautifully updated living space in one of San Francisco's most charming neighborhoods. The main level features a chef's kitchen with Silestone quartz counters, mosaic tile backsplash, abundant cabinetry, pantry, premium appliances, and a 6-burner Thermador gas range. A bay-window breakfast nook with built-in bench flows to a formal dining room and a grand living room with vaulted ceilings, dramatic picture window, period fireplace, and original detailing. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet and spa-like bath with multi-fixture shower, marble-topped vanity, and storage nook. Two additional bedrooms share a hall bath with Waterworks/Dornbracht fixtures, custom tilework, soaking tub, separate shower, and heated floors. The lower level offers two spacious flex rooms, a full bath, and laundry areaideal for media, work, or guests. Landscaped gardens feature irrigation and a hardscaped rear patio. Spacious 2+ car garage, modernized systems, and a prime location near Stonestown, West Portal, and transit complete this exceptional home.
